item.title: How in-store music influences customer behaviour in ANZ
item.description: Across both markets, around 40 per cent of customers report leaving a venue because of the music. The post How in-store music influences customer behaviour in ANZ appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: Women entrepreneurs plan to work beyond 65, survey finds
item.description: “These findings show that women over 45 ... are building sustainable, strategic ventures with clear growth and exit plans.” The post Women entrepreneurs plan to work beyond 65, survey finds appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: Businesses urged to embed sexual harassment prevention in WHS policies
item.description: The industry body said sexual harassment should be treated as a preventable workplace hazard. The post Businesses urged to embed sexual harassment prevention in WHS policies appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: One foot back, two feet forward
item.description: Denise transitioned from her market stall to becoming a million-dollar business, with loyal customers, stockists, and strong word-of-mouth recommendations. The post One foot back, two feet forward appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: Now is the perfect time to boost your cyber resilience
item.description: Cyber criminals are continuously updating their tactics, so businesses must do the same if they wish to improve their ability to prevent, detect and respond to attacks. The post Now is the perfect time to boost your cyber resilience appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: To AI or not to AI?
item.description: “AI should be treated as an extra layer on top of existing search and brand work.” The post To AI or not to AI? appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: A pristine solution to salty problems
item.description: We created a harvesting process that uses naturally-occurring energy sources – including solar energy, the thermal energy of the ocean, and high natural evaporation rates unique to our part of Tasmania The post A pristine solution to salty problems appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: Why crowd-sourced funding has become a serious growth option for SMEs
item.description: At its core, crowd-sourced funding allows businesses to raise funds from the people who already believe in them. The post Why crowd-sourced funding has become a serious growth option for SMEs appeared first on Inside Small Business.

item.title: Scholarship for aspiring beauty entrepreneurs launched to boost small players
item.description: The Future Entrepreneur Scholarship program aims to support beauty industry graduates not only in their work but also in business ownership. The post Scholarship for aspiring beauty entrepreneurs launched to boost small players appeared first on Inside Small Business.
